documents.title: SYNTHETIC ONLY — SYN-ALPHA pilot trial
documents.content:
# SYN-ALPHA pilot trial

Synthetic evaluation material. Not a real company, experiment, approval, or policy.

## Conditions
SYN-ALPHA material on machine M1 was evaluated at 250 C for 30 min and 20 MPa. The purpose was compatibility, not maximum throughput.

## Results
12 specimens produced an observed yield of 91 percent. This small pilot does not establish production yield.

## Scope
The result applies only to the stated material, machine and conditions.

documents.title: SYNTHETIC ONLY — SYN-BETA throughput trial
documents.content:
# SYN-BETA throughput trial

Synthetic evaluation material. Not a real company, experiment, approval, or policy.

## Conditions
SYN-BETA material on machine M2 was evaluated at 300 C for 10 min and 10 MPa. The purpose was throughput.

## Results
120 specimens produced an observed yield of 88 percent. Material, machine, duration and evaluation purpose differ from SYN-ALPHA.

## Scope
This is not a controlled head-to-head comparison with SYN-ALPHA.
